title: A failed connector start leaves Debezium Server up, idle
symptom: No events from one source; its Debezium Server was up; its log had 'Engine has failed' (ORA-17002, connection validation timed out)
cause: Debezium Server 3.7 keeps the process alive when the engine fails to start
effect: Silent data stop: nothing errors in Zerobus or Databricks
fix: Watch each server's log for 'Starting streaming'; restart it on 'Engine has failed'
